title: Men's Disc Golf – Parked It. In a Tree. Hoodie

seo.title: Disc Golf Hoodie – Parked It. In a Tree.
seo.description: A funny disc golf hoodie for the player whose disc is in a tree: PARKED IT. IN A TREE. Gildan pullover, 8 oz fleece, Sand or Navy.

descriptionHtml:
The Story

PARKED IT. IN A TREE. is the disc golf hoodie for the player whose best drive ended up thirty feet up a pine, worn to league night, the cold Saturday round and the walk back to the car without the disc.

PARKED IT. runs across the top and IN A TREE. fills the bottom, even wider, in heavy rounded capitals. Between them a disc golfer in a knit beanie and flannel shirt stands at the foot of a tall pine with his hands on his hips, staring up with a flat, unimpressed face at a bright orange disc stuck in the top branches, a small chain basket standing behind him.

Navy carries cream and orange lettering with a cream edge around the tree; Sand gets dark green and deep rust lettering. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Classic unisex fit, pullover with a double-lined hood and matching drawcord
  • 50% pre-shrunk cotton, 50% polyester
  • Fabric weight: 8.0 oz/yd²
  • Air-jet spun yarn with a soft feel
  • Front pouch pocket, ribbed cuffs and waistband with spandex
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • Colors: Sand, Navy
  • Blank product sourced from Bangladesh, Nicaragua, Honduras or El Salvador

Questions

Is this hoodie warm enough for a cold round?
Yes. The Parked It. In a Tree. hoodie from Graphic Tees Co. is a Gildan 18500 pullover in 8 oz fleece, 50% cotton and 50% polyester, with a double-lined hood and a front pouch pocket. It is an easy layer for cold Saturday rounds, league nights and long walks to the next tee.

How does the Parked It. In a Tree. hoodie fit?
It is a classic unisex cut in sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size for a regular fit, or go up one for a roomier layer over a work shirt. If it is not right, Graphic Tees Co. offers a free size exchange, so the first pick carries no risk at all.

Is this a good gift for a disc golfer?
It is a natural one. Every disc golfer has watched a disc land in a tree and stay there, so the joke lands with league mates, partners and the guy who keeps buying discs. It comes in Sand and Navy, prints to order, and the free size exchange covers a wrong guess on size.

How do I wash the hoodie so the print lasts?
Turn the Graphic Tees Co. hoodie inside out, wash it in cold water with similar colors and tumble dry on low. Skip bleach and ironing on the print. The design is printed directly on the fabric, so gentle care keeps the lettering and the disc golfer sharp wash after wash.

When should I order for Christmas delivery?
Order by about December 8 to have the Parked It. In a Tree. hoodie for Christmas. Each Graphic Tees Co. hoodie is printed to order after you buy, and shipping is free on orders over $45. Orders placed after that date may arrive after the holiday, so earlier is safer.
